title: TEMs but Not DKK1 could Serve as Complementary Biomarkers for AFP in Diagnosing Hepatocellular Carcinoma
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.irhcd36

steps.title: Prepare Patient Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect 3 ml of whole blood from fasting patients using heparin as an anticoagulant before treatment. Perform the experiment within 2 hours of collection.

steps.title: Prepare and Label Test Tubes
steps.instruction: Label two flow cytometry test tubes as '+B' and '+T' using a marker pen.

steps.title: Aliquot Whole Blood
steps.instruction: Mix each specimen thoroughly by slow inversion of the sample tube 10 times, then add 100 μl of whole blood to both the +B and +T tubes.

steps.title: Block Fc Receptors
steps.instruction: Add 20 μl of FcR blocking reagent to each tube, vortex at middle speed for 5-10 seconds, and incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature protected from light.

steps.title: Add Primary Antibodies
steps.instruction: Add the following antibodies to the tubes as specified:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 μl of CD14-FITC mouse anti-human antibody to both tubes.
Add 10 μl of CD16-PE-Cy5 mouse anti-human antibody to both tubes.
Add 1 μl of TIE2-PE mouse anti-human antibody to the +T tube.
Add 1 μl of IgG1-k-PE mouse anti-human antibody to the +B tube.

steps.title: Incubate Antibodies
steps.instruction: Mix each tube thoroughly by middle speed vortexing for 5-10 seconds and incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Perform Hemolysis
steps.instruction: Treat the samples with hemolysis reagents to remove red blood cells:

substeps.instruction: Add 600 μl of hemolysis reagent A (0.12% methanoic acid) to each tube and vortex at middle speed for 5-10 seconds.
Add 270 μl of hemolysis reagent B (Na2CO3 6.0 g/L, NaCl 14.5 g/L, Na2SO4 31.3 g/L) to each tube and vortex at middle speed for 5-10 seconds.

steps.title: Wash Cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice using PBS and centrifugation:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 ml of PBS to each tube, blow gently to mix, centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes, and pour off the supernatant after inspecting for a white film at the bottom.
Add 2.0 ml of PBS to each tube, blow gently to mix, centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes, and pour off the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend and Analyze
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 0.5 ml of PBS by blowing gently and mixing evenly. Analyze immediately via flow cytometry, counting at least 10,000 CD14+ monocytes per sample.

steps.title: Calculate TEM Percentage
steps.instruction: Evaluate the percentage of TEMs in CD14+CD16+ monocytes by subtracting the value obtained from the IgG1-k-PE isotype control (+B tube) from the TIE2-PE staining (+T tube).
